hashicorp_tfe_provider_version_support.notes: Added workspace auto-apply on plan trigger support.
Minor line used in this repo until the Q4 2026 upgrade to 0.82 (docs/dependency-upgrade-plan-2026-q4.md, Phase 2a).
Exact version pinned in all tf_cloud and cluster-addons-layer env configs (version = "0.68.2") until Phase 2a replaced the pin with ~> 0.82.
Breaking: all resources moved to the latest plugin protocol; requires Terraform >= 1.0.0. r/tfe_oauth_client oauth_token no longer forces replacement on its own.
Breaking: write-only attributes (tfe_variable value_wo, notification token_wo, ssh_key key_wo, etc.) gained *_wo_version counterparts. None used in this repo.
Breaking: r/tfe_workspace hyok_enabled became computed read-only; configs that set it error after upgrade. Not set in this repo.
Constraint ~> 0.82 in the tf_cloud_workspaces module and all tf_cloud and cluster-addons-layer env configs since Phase 2a; lock files resolve to 0.82.0. No breaking changes.
